title: Sordland/Turn04/InT_TaurusRailwayIssue
description: Half of the first infrastructure project has been completed. But further progress has been halted due to an issue which the player must choose to solve in a way. Dependant on each corporation a different issue appears and all of them have different absolute solutions or failures leading to making the opening deadline or missing it by two months.

entries.dialogueText: “We scheduled the construction to finish sooner but Taurus Holding might miss that target with the current trajectory.”

entries.dialogueText: “On top of it, this will affect all the companies in Sordland causing them to pay extra money to their employees. This small matter shouldn't have affected the whole country.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
